salmon.method: At original hold N frame05, map approved canonical alpha samples to the mathematically required fullUV plane at unchanged source width/origin/matrix, new aspect height; ray-test against evaluated opaque native actor only. No geometry/image-node change and no canonical candidate rendering. Sampling stride4, alpha>=0.5. Overlay samples are in front of an actor surface rather than hidden behind it.
